resources.string: Choose Where to Store Your Data

Your records remain on this device for offline use. After onboarding, open Settings → Google Drive backup to connect your Google account, back up, or restore with your recovery password. App lock does not encrypt the local database.
Start tracking your expenses to see them here.
Coming soon in a future update

Delete this transaction? This cannot be undone.
Could not save changes. Your form is still here; please try again.
A planned payment needs your attention. Open GharHisab to review.
Allow notifications to receive payment reminders. You can continue without them or enable them in Android notification settings.
Reminders are scheduled around 9 AM. Android may delay delivery. Unpaid bills stay unpaid until you confirm payment.
The operation could not be completed. Your data was retained; check the details and try again.
Record %1$s as paid for %2$s? A real expense will be created.
Delete this plan? Any already recorded payment remains in your transactions.
Your recovery key disables the forgotten app PIN without deleting financial data. Without either credential, restore an encrypted backup on another installation.
Use your device biometric or screen lock. If unavailable, check Android security settings.
Authentication failed or temporarily blocked. After five incorrect attempts, wait at least 30 seconds; repeated failures increase the delay.
Save this recovery key somewhere private, outside this phone. It can disable your app PIN. It is shown only now; losing both PIN and key prevents access to this installation.
An interrupted restore could not be recovered. Close the app and retry. Do not clear app data; your encrypted recovery archive is retained.

Manual backup and restore, not automatic two-way sync. Sync Now checks the latest snapshots. Uploads create separate encrypted copies in the hidden app data folder. Restore requires your recovery password and confirmation.
Connect the Google account containing your backups. Google Play services and configured Android OAuth access are required.
Connected. Select a backup to preview before restoring.
No GharHisab backup found in this account.
Cloud operation failed. Check internet access, Google Play services, Drive API/OAuth setup, or the recovery password. Local data remains available.
Google access expired or was revoked. Connect again to retry.
Keep your recovery password outside this phone. It is never uploaded or saved. Losing it makes the cloud backup unrecoverable.
Restore replaces local financial records and balance settings. An encrypted local safety copy is kept for rollback. Newer local changes will not be merged.
Estimate based on recorded activity, not a guarantee
Funds may run out around %1$s if this spending continues.
No supported depletion date yet: balance or history may be insufficient, or funds may last beyond the one-year forecast.
Recent spending is higher than the previous period.
Recent spending exceeds the recommended daily amount. Review upcoming payments and optional spending.

Daily limit = balance minus unpaid commitments and reserve, divided by remaining month days (including today), capped by your remaining budget. Reserve defaults to zero and is editable in Settings. Forecast weights the last 7 days twice as much as the previous 7; paid planned bills are excluded from the daily rate. Future income is not assumed.
Your spending outlook changed. Open GharHisab to review privately.
Your plan is saved, but Android could not schedule all reminders. Reopen the app to retry and check notification settings.
Google authorization failed. Retry Connect; use the error code below when troubleshooting.
Drive rejected the request. Check account access or retry later.
This backup exceeds the supported size limit. Choose another backup.
The password is incorrect or the encrypted file is damaged. No records were restored.
The backup format or financial values are invalid or unsupported. No records were restored.
Local data changed. Close this preview and preview the backup again before restoring.
Upload could not be confirmed. Refresh the backup list before retrying to avoid duplicate snapshots.
Could not reach Drive. Check your connection and retry this operation.
Could not create the encrypted backup. Check local financial values and available storage.
Could not refresh the backup list. Retry Refresh; an acknowledged upload is still successful.
Could not download this backup. Refresh the list and try again.
Restore could not finish. Retry after checking storage. If recovery is blocked, restart the app without clearing its data.
Operation stopped. See the details below.
Suggested allowance for the rest of this month
An alert when your spending needs attention
No depletion predicted within the next year at this spending rate.
Add income or a starting balance to make your forecast useful.
Add a few days of spending to see a money forecast.
Allow notifications for spending alerts. Your amounts stay private; you can turn alerts off at any time.
Alerts are selected, but Android notifications are blocked.
Unlock to view your household finances.
Enter the recovery code saved when you set up your app PIN. It resets the app lock and keeps your financial records. It is separate from your Google account and backup password.
If you did not save the code, try your app PIN. Do not clear app data: that deletes local records.
Say a description, an amount, or both. Speaking only an amount keeps your description. Fields you edit manually stay unchanged.

If you selected an account, check the Android OAuth client in your Google Cloud project. Its package and SHA-1 must match this installed app. Also check consent-screen test users. Copy the values below; no client secret is needed.
Your speech service does not support this language. Choose another language or use manual entry.
This speech language is not installed. Enable or download it in your device speech settings, or use manual entry.
Calendar dates need manual entry. Open manual entry to choose the transaction date.
